entries.title: Name Coin Bank
entries.description: Chunky name-shaped coin bank with a hollow body, drop-in front plate, coin slot and twist-lock cap.
entries.updateNote: New Flat bottom slider: raise it to cut the base lower so letters that float because of the font shape sit flat.

entries.title: Classic Coin Bank
entries.description: Ready-made coin bank with your text on the front: embossed, as puzzle inserts, or inlaid for multicolor.
entries.updateNote: New: turn off the access cap for a sealed bank, and pick from six colour presets. The front plate no longer shows dark smudges.

entries.title: Name Fidget Clicker
entries.description: Text-shaped mechanical clicker — thick silhouette base and keycap, molded or shell, optional keyring.
entries.updateNote: Up to 3 lines of text — each line has its own font, size, justify and colour, and the clicker outline wraps them all.

entries.title: Image to Clicker
entries.description: Turn a character from your Art gallery into a mechanical clicker: a hollow base shaped like it and a matching multicolor keycap.
entries.updateNote: Smoother outlines: Fill gaps closes deep notches between letters, so the keycap and base have no thin slivers. Click a colour part to drag its height arrow, now in the exploded view too, with a live see-through preview.

entries.title: Name Desk Standee
entries.description: Multi-line desk name with a solid stand bar; optional outline.

entries.title: Sweeping Name Standee
entries.description: Name text swept along an arc into a self-standing curved wedge with a name-shaped foot.

entries.title: Letter Rail
entries.description: Big initial with your name running across it — placement tuned for every letter A–Z.

entries.title: Text Blocks
entries.description: Stacked blocks with a different letter on each side; spin them to spell names or words.

entries.title: Flexi Name Keychain
entries.description: Flexible keychain where each letter of your name links together.

entries.title: Multicolor Whistle
entries.description: Working whistle in up to three colors, with your name on top.

entries.title: Whistle Bag Tag
entries.description: Whistle bag tag with your name — great for backpacks and luggage.

entries.title: Name Keychain
entries.description: Your name or words as a keychain, with optional border, text outline and keyring.

entries.title: QR Code Maker
entries.description: Scannable QR keychain for a link, message, Wi‑Fi, or contact info.

entries.title: Spotify Code Keychain
entries.description: Paste a Spotify link and get a scannable song code keychain.

entries.title: Freeform Design Canvas
entries.description: Arrange text and shapes on a canvas, then turn it into a 3D print.
entries.updateNote: Heads up: this designer will be retired soon, replaced by Artwork Maker (lay out text, shapes and art) and the upcoming Artwork to 3D designer. Export anything you want to keep.

entries.title: Motorcycle Plate Bar
entries.description: Custom bar accessory for motorcycle plates — add your text.
entries.updateNote: Faster with decorative fonts like Kablammo, and reloading on the layout no longer shows a half-drawn bar first.

entries.title: Cake Topper
entries.description: Birthday topper with your message — pick one or two sticks.

entries.title: Wavy ID Badge
entries.description: Badge-style name tag you can customize with text and colors.

entries.title: Shaped ID Tag
entries.description: Pick a ready-made tag shape, then add your name and colors.
entries.updateNote: New default colorways (Creamberry, Sky Peach, Matcha Rose and more) with separate border, nickname and full-name colors.

entries.title: Classic Name Tag
entries.description: Flat name tag with multiple text lines, alignment, hole styles and optional icons.

entries.title: Address Number Sign
entries.description: House or unit number sign with optional frame and screw holes.

entries.title: Door Name Plaque
entries.description: Decorative door or room sign with raised name and fancy border.

entries.title: Letter Keycap Set
entries.description: Type custom letters and symbols for a full keyboard keycap set.

entries.title: Letter Beads
entries.description: Chunky rounded beads for each letter or number with a cord hole — defaults to A–Z and 0–9.
entries.updateNote: Letter Beads is now a Pro designer: anyone can design with it, and exports come with Pro.
entries.maintenanceNote: Temporarily offline while we fix bead export reliability. Other designers remain available.

entries.title: Engraved Name Tag
entries.description: Raised border with recessed name — fill in color on a second piece.

entries.title: Bumpy Text
entries.description: Fun 3D name where each letter sticks out a different height.

entries.title: Ribbon Bow
entries.description: Bow-shaped keychain with your name — sweet for bags and keys.
entries.updateNote: New: move the name anywhere on the bow with the Pos X and Pos Y sliders.

entries.title: Pickleball Paddle
entries.description: Paddle-shaped keychain with an icon of your choice on the face, in two colors.

entries.title: Pickleball Paddle End Cap
entries.description: Custom circular paddle end cap with adjustable size, raised border, and curved text.
entries.updateNote: The face is now artwork: lay out text, icons, shapes and gallery art in Artwork Maker (kept inside the border, which the editor shows), then give each colour its own raised height and colour. Older designs open with their text and icons as artwork.

entries.title: Round Badge & Chip
entries.description: Round badge or chip with adjustable size, raised border, curved text, and an optional keyring hole.
entries.updateNote: The face is now artwork: lay out text, icons, shapes and gallery art in Artwork Maker (kept inside the border, which the editor shows), then give each colour its own raised height and colour. Older designs open with their text and icons as artwork.

entries.title: Instagram Tag
entries.description: Capsule keychain with Instagram logo and @username — auto-fit width, two colors, left keyring.

entries.title: Basketball Hoop Tag
entries.description: Mini basketball hoop keychain with your name and team colors.

entries.title: Name Puzzle
entries.description: Letters pop in and out of a board — kids spell the name as they play.
entries.updateNote: Exported boards now have the same corner rounding as the preview, including with very round corners.

entries.title: Layered Monogram
entries.description: Big initial with your full name beside it on one layered keychain.

entries.title: Monogram Insert
entries.description: Large initial with a name piece that presses into it, for a clean two-color print.
entries.updateNote: The 3D preview shows the initial cleanly: no more dark, shiny streaks on its flat faces.

entries.title: Floral Initial
entries.description: Flower-shaped keychain with your initial in the center.

entries.title: Pet ID Tag
entries.description: Classic pet tag shape — add your dog or cat's name.

entries.title: Icon Charm
entries.description: Pick an icon and turn it into a thick charm for cord or chain.
entries.updateNote: Exports now work with a base offset of 0, and the cord hole always runs through the whole charm, also on large charms and in the vertical direction.

entries.title: Icon Keycap
entries.description: Add a small icon or logo on top of a single keycap.

entries.title: Basic Whistle
entries.description: Simple working whistle keychain personalized with your name.

entries.title: Straw Name Clip
entries.description: Clips onto a straw so everyone knows whose drink is whose.

entries.title: Pencil Name Sleeve
entries.description: Name sleeve that slides onto a pencil for school or gifts.

entries.title: Puffy Letter Keychain
entries.description: Puffy two-part name keychain: a balloon cushion with letter pockets and separate puffy letters that press in after printing.

entries.title: Valorant Keychain
entries.description: Valorant-inspired keychain with layered red border and logo over white text on a black base.

entries.title: 3D Model Decal
entries.description: Put text, icons or your Art gallery artwork on a flat face of your own STL or 3MF model, extruded or inlaid in color.
entries.updateNote: Turned pieces now come out turned the way the layout shows them (they were mirrored before). Lay out art with Artwork Maker in the layout step, or pick an Artwork Maker design from your gallery.

entries.title: Charm Maker
entries.description: Turn your Art gallery artwork into a thick charm for cord or chain, in stacked or side-by-side colors.
entries.updateNote: Click colour parts in the preview to select them (shift-click for more) and drag the orange arrow to change their height or the layer depth.

entries.title: Trinket Tray Maker
entries.description: Turn your Art gallery artwork into a trinket tray: the artwork inlaid flush in the floor, with a wall that follows its outline.

entries.title: Screw Top Container
entries.description: A round container with a screw-on lid that closes in about one turn: a keychain pill box, a charm case or a small jar, with text on the lid.
entries.updateNote: Lid artwork now prints at the size you lay it out on the whole lid (anything past the flat top is cut off, never shrunk). Click artwork parts in the preview or the parts list, and with Embossed drag the arrow to raise each part to its own height.

entries.title: Snap-Fit Box
entries.description: A personalized storage box with a compact snap-together hinge. Print the body and lid separately; no hinge pin needed.
entries.imageAlt: Rounded storage box with a teal lid, cream inlay, and integrated hinge
entries.updateNote: Create lid artwork right in the designer with Artwork Maker, then insert it or save it to your gallery. The lid now closes flush, and lid art reads the right way up from the latch side.

entries.title: Phone Grip Topper
entries.description: A name topper for a round phone grip: groovy lettering packed into the circle, printed as a flat multicolor topper.
entries.imageAlt: Phone Grip Topper preview: chunky pink bubble lettering filling a round yellow topper
entries.updateNote: New Topper diameter slider: make the printed disc smaller than the grip top, and the art scales with it.

entries.title: Christmas Ornament
entries.description: Personalized round ornament in four holiday styles: a name on a nameplate with snowflakes, evergreen trees and an integrated hanging loop, in up to four colors.
entries.imageAlt: Christmas Ornament preview: an ivory-framed round ornament with a red nameplate, green fields and ivory snowflakes

entries.title: Vial Case
entries.description: A holder for your vials with one reversible snap-on shell: a protective cap over the vials, or flip it to make a stable base. Sized from your vial measurements, 1–24 vials.
entries.imageAlt: Vial Case: a cream two-vial holder with glass vials and black caps, its purple snap-on shell lifted above
entries.updateNote: Cap artwork parts can now be selected in the preview, and embossed art can be pulled taller with the orange arrow, part by part.

entries.title: Stackable Basket
entries.description: Create customizable stackable storage baskets and organizer trays with adjustable dimensions, shapes, textures, handles, and dividers.
entries.imageAlt: Stackable Basket preview: two sage-green fluted storage baskets stacked, with rounded handle slots, beside a folded towel and a small plant

entries.title: Image to Keychain
entries.description: Turn your Art gallery artwork into an outlined keychain with a keyring tab you can move around the edge.
